Name: Artisan Goods Keep Quality
Author: voiddreams
Description:
What it says on the tin! Whatever quality you put in is the quality you get back. Works on all base-game artisan machines (with the exception of the Cask, since it doesn't actually [i]produce[/i] anything). Large eggs and milk give 2 output with the same quality.

Requires Content Patcher and, by extension, SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is not required, but is highly recommended, especially if playing with other mods.

If there's a specific compatibility option you're interested in, let me know and I'll see what I can do. I am unable to add compatibility with Producer Framework Manager mods at this time.

[b]If you are reporting a problem, please [url=https://smapi.io/log]upload a SMAPI log[/url] so I can look at the full error sheet and mod list.[/b]

COMPATIBILITY:
- Works with Automate
- Shouldn't break other mods, so long as they don't change the same things.
- Will not work with custom machines or products unless there's a compatibility patch added (see below). It won't break them, but they won't get the benefits of this mod.
